description.en: Math-literature knowledge base with page numbers, sources and verification status: 1,250 structured cards (concepts / theorems / proof skeletons / argument chains / errata) from 45 works of translated mathematics, bundled in the package so it works right after install. Pure-JS search (no Python, no SQLite, zero config). Each hit carries a page number, a source grade and a caveat — it gives you leads with provenance, not answers.
description.zh: 带页码、带来源、带可信度的数学文献知识库：随包自带 1,250 张结构化卡片（概念/定理/证明骨架/论证链/勘误），来自 45 部已译数学文献，装好即查。纯 JS 检索，不依赖 Python / SQLite，零配置。每条结果都带原文页码、来源等级与 caveat —— 给的是带出处的线索，不是结论。
